About the Role
Our client is looking for an experienced DevSecOps Engineer to join its engineering team and help maintain and evolve its standardised, in-house DevSecOps toolchain. The toolchain is the common development platform used by the organisation’s software teams to build, secure and deliver their products.
You will support development teams in migrating to the platform, extend it to deliver software packages securely to more restricted environments, and help ensure that software products comply with new cybersecurity regulations. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of software delivery, security and compliance.
Business Context
Several upcoming programmes are shaping the work ahead:
Ongoing projects require software packages to be delivered securely to more restricted network environments, which calls for additional components and implementation on top of the existing platform.
The organisation is upgrading its IT service management system to the new BMC Helix, and the platform’s integration components must be adapted accordingly.
Tooling is being migrated to Atlassian Cloud.
The EU regulation on information security (Part-IS, Commission Implementing Regulation 2023/203) comes into force in 2026. Compliance in the area of vulnerability management requires Software Bills of Materials (SBOM) and static source code analysis for all relevant subsystems.
Key Responsibilities
Support existing products running on the DevSecOps platform and resolve issues raised by development teams.
Onboard new products and teams onto the platform, guiding them through migration.
Maintain and evolve the platform’s release and deployment components, including adapting them for the Helix/Remedy upgrade and the Atlassian Cloud migration.
Design and implement new components for secure artefact transfer and promotion to more restricted environments.
Produce SBOMs and implement static source code analysis in CI/CD pipelines to support regulatory compliance.
Monitor platform components, identify risks and obstacles, and make sure product-related problems are addressed.
Review priorities, make recommendations, take part in decision-making and coordinate with the relevant teams.
Document solutions and share knowledge with development teams.
Required Qualifications
Proven experience in a DevSecOps, DevOps or platform engineering role.
Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and tooling (for example Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar) and of artefact repository management (for example Nexus or Artifactory).
Experience with SBOM generation, software composition analysis and static application security testing (SAST).
Good understanding of secure software supply chain practices and vulnerability management.
Scripting and automation skills (for example Python, Bash, Groovy) and experience with infrastructure as code.
Experience with Atlassian tools and ITSM systems (Jira, Confluence, BMC Remedy/Helix or similar), including integrations.
Ability to work with development teams, communicate clearly and coordinate with several stakeholders.
Fluent English, written and spoken.
[Degree level or equivalent experience].
Eligibility to work with the client and to pass the required security vetting, with nationality criteria as per the client’s rules.
Nice to Have
Familiarity with cybersecurity regulation and standards (Part-IS, ISO 27001, IEC 62443 or similar).
Experience delivering software to segregated, air-gapped or highly restricted environments.
Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and with messaging platforms such as Kafka.
Experience in regulated or safety-critical sectors such as aviation, transport, energy or public administration.
Knowledge of agile ways of working.

The War Child Alliance 

The War Child Alliance Foundation is an international non-governmental organisation (NGO) committed to supporting children affected by armed conflict. We work alongside partners, governments, educators, caregivers and communities to strengthen children’s wellbeing and learning, protect them from harm, and ensure that war does not define their futures.

Central to our approach are evidence-based methodologies, using research and learning from thirty years of experience to build evidence of what works and expand effective approaches across different contexts.

Our global teams work across different countries and regions, bringing together expertise and experience from diverse contexts. Job Description:
Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you.

We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About This Role

As our CRM Platform Engineer, you will join the CRM Platforms team—the exclusive owners and experts of the CRM technology stack at Just Eat Takeaway.com.

This is a Junior to Medior level role, making it the perfect landing spot for someone who is hungry to grow. You don’t need a heavy technical background to start; if you have a solid logical foundation and a passion for learning, we will provide the onboarding and mentorship you need to become a specialist. You’ll be mentored by experts as you take ownership of industry-leading tools like Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and Hightouch. You aren't just a support function; you are a platform owner, ensuring our tech is reliable, automated, and ready for the next big innovation.

These are some of the key components to the position:

Platform Ownership: Take pride in managing our CRM ecosystem, aiming high to ensure platforms are healthy and performing at their full potential.
Technical Enablement: Support global CRM teams by driving excellence in the technical aspects of their campaigns and finding the best solutions.
Continuous Learning: Deep dive into Salesforce Developer Experience (DX) and master the "under the hood" mechanics of CRM engineering.
Bridge the Gap: Collaborate with non-technical stakeholders to translate campaign goals into technical reality through clear communication.
Automation & Reliability: Help manage data flows via Hightouch, ensuring our platforms are scalable and capable of reaching millions of customers.
Proactive Delivery: Bring a "get things done" attitude to every task, taking responsibility for high-quality results from start to finish.

What will you bring to the team?

A Solid Foundation: You have a basic understanding of CRM platforms and a logical mindset to help us stay committed to achieving goals.
Eagerness to Learn: A genuine curiosity for "Marketing Tech" and a desire to aim higher and drive excellence in tools like Braze and SFMC.
Strong Communication: You can simplify complex ideas for non-technical colleagues, helping the team move fast and create clarity.
Collaborative Spirit: You develop an understanding of internal and external partners to ensure we are doing what is right for our users.
Project Management: You are organised and act responsibly while managing your workload to make a lasting impact.
Problem-Solving: You enjoy diving into challenges and aren't afraid to ask questions to help the team succeed.
Fluency in English: Essential for collaborating with our diverse global teams and navigating our technical documentation.

At JET, this is how we play

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again. Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.
